steps.input:
source='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(x for row in grid for x in row)
    bg = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    line = next(color for color, _ in counts.most_common() if color != bg)
    rs = [r for r in range(h) if sum(v == line for v in grid[r]) >= w * 0.55]
    cs = [c for c in range(w) if sum(grid[r][c] == line for r in range(h)) >= h * 0.55]
    nodes = [[grid[r][c] for c in cs] for r in rs]
    marked = [(i, j) for i, row in enumerate(nodes) for j, v in enumerate(row) if v != bg and v != line]
    r0 = min(i for i, j in marked); r1 = max(i for i, j in marked)
    c0 = min(j for i, j in marked); c1 = max(j for i, j in marked)
    nodes = [row[c0:c1+1] for row in nodes[r0:r1+1]]
    return [[nodes[i][j] if nodes[i][j] == nodes[i+1][j] == nodes[i][j+1] == nodes[i+1][j+1] and nodes[i][j] not in (bg, line) else bg
             for j in range(len(nodes[0])-1)] for i in range(len(nodes)-1)]
'''
